# Beeond

> Beeond helps businesses stand out in the AI era with a system and service
> built on full transparency: a dashboard shows exactly what is being done,
> at what volume, and why, while a swarm of AI agents executes at speed and
> scale behind it. A human oversees the process to guarantee quality.

## Status

Pre-launch. This site is being rebuilt from scratch as of 2026-08-26.
No offer, pricing, or service catalog is published yet — those are open
decisions, not withheld information. Trademark clearance is in progress.

## Founders

- Adam — AI systems and agent swarms
- Yarden Morgan — marketing and growth
